basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NEERI Project Scientist II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI) has released the recruitment notification for 1 temporary Project Scientist-II vacancy under its 2026 recruitment drive. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, with a notified pay of Rs. 67,000 + HRA. Applicants for the Project Scientist-II post must possess an M. E / M. Tech in Civil/ Chemical/ Mechanical/ Environmental Engineering or Technology from a recognized University, along with 5 years’ experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified separately on www.neeri.res.in

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.neeri.res.in to access the online application portal.
Fill out the online application form completely with all required details before the last date.
Ensure that essential qualifications and results are declared with at least a provisional certificate prior to applying.
Submit the online application form on or before 22-10-2026.
Keep a record of the application submission for future reference related to the online interview.
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and do not confer any right for regularization against any CSIR-NEERI post. Candidates are not required to pay any application fees. Only candidates who have acquired essential qualifications and whose results have been declared are eligible to apply. Result-awaited or final semester appearing candidates are not eligible. Experience is counted from the date after acquiring minimum educational qualification; academic dissertation or thesis work is not counted. Selected candidates must sign an undertaking for maintaining the confidentiality of project findings and intellectual property. Project staff must make their own arrangements for accommodation during their tenure, though HRA is admissible as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces 1 active vacancy for the Project Scientist-II (PS-II) position, with an anticipated vacancy of up to 3 posts depending upon the availability of funds and selection from the waiting list.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualification criteria prescribed for the position. The eligibility details are as follows: Essential Qualification: M. E / M. Tech in Civil/ Chemical/ Mechanical/ Environmental Engineering or Technology from a recognized University. Experience: 5 years’ experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. Upper Age Limit: 40 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a monthly emolument of Rs. 67,000/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable rules. An increment of 5% will be provided for every 2 years of experience in the same project. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other laboratories/Institutes of CSIR under contract R&D projects is subject to limits as per CSIR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Scientist-II Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Project Scientist-II will be responsible for the following duties and tasks: Field Monitoring and Laboratory analysis of Ambient Air. Source apportionment (PMF, CMB). Size distribution and chemical composition. Integration of AI/ML in Air pollution Problem. Skilled in Python Programming Language.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEERI Project Scientist-II
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.neeri.res.in to access the online application portal. Fill out the online application form completely with all required details before the last date. Ensure that essential qualifications and results are declared with at least a provisional certificate prior to applying. Submit the online application form on or before 22-10-2026. Keep a record of the application submission for future reference related to the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be done on the basis of an online interview conducted through MS Teams, Skype, or other online platforms. The date of the interview will be notified separately on the official website. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the online interview based on criteria adopted by the Screening Committee.
